rubric: This is a gaming video or stream transcript. A great clip is ONE play or moment: a clutch, a fail, a glitch, an outplay or a funny exchange, with the setup that makes it land (what is at stake, what they are trying) and the reaction after it. A strong, specific hot take on a game also works when it gives its reason. Reject menus, loading, looting and walking with no stakes, settings talk, and sponsor reads. A 💬 after the time marks a sentence where Twitch chat blew up in the seconds just after it (spam, KEKW/LUL, CLIP IT) - a strong hint the reaction landed. Judge by meaning; 💬 is a signal, not a guarantee.
outline: A topic is one play, round, fight or match moment, or one opinion about one game or feature. A new topic starts at the next round, the next fight, a new objective, or a change of subject. Menus, loading screens and idle travel belong to no topic.
review: A gaming clip must show the stakes before the play and end after the reaction to it: not on the next round starting, a menu, or talk about something else.
